level.title: Give Minion the Wheel
level.subdescription:
Until now you have been giving orders and your Minion has been answering. You still do every real thing yourself.
That changes here. Stay in the same chat, connect your Minion to your actual calendar, and give it one goal instead of a list of steps. Then watch it act in the real world.

what_are_mcps:
Everything your Minion has done so far happened inside the chat window. It can read your data. It can answer hard questions. It can build you a deck.

But it cannot touch anything outside.

MCP — Model Context Protocol — is the open standard that changes that. It is a common language that lets Claude talk to real tools: your calendar, your drive, your ticketing system, your database. Connectors are the individual doors built on that standard, and you open them one at a time.

Today you open one door. Your Minion will read your real schedule, find a genuinely free slot, write the invite, and send it. You give the goal. It works out the steps.
mission_targets: Connect Google Calendar to Claude as a Connector
Watch your Minion read your real schedule rather than guessing
Give it a goal, not a set of steps, and let it work out the sequence
Send a real invite carrying everything you built across all four levels

mission_gear.name: MCPs
mission_gear.definition: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to the tools and data where your work actually lives.
mission_gear.theme_translation: Think of MCP as the secret tunnel out of Gru's lair. You do not need to understand how the tunnel was dug. You just need to know it means your Minion can finally leave the building.
why_useful: Claude stops being a place you ask things and becomes a place things get done
One standard, so any tool that supports it can plug in
Your Minion works from live data, not a copy you pasted in
New tools join the ecosystem constantly

mission_gear.name: Connectors
mission_gear.definition: The individual integrations built on MCP. Each one gives Claude permission to read from, and act inside, one specific tool you already use.
mission_gear.theme_translation: If MCP is the tunnel, a Connector is a door with your name on it. You choose which doors to open, and you can close any of them whenever you want.
why_useful: Connect once and every future chat can use it
You control exactly which tools it can reach
Removes the copy-paste step between AI and your real work
This is what people actually mean by an AI agent

mission_check: My Minion read my real schedule and listed my events
My Minion found a genuinely free slot in my calendar
My Minion wrote and sent the invite from one instruction
